scenes.headline: How one small model absorbs a dozen specialists
scenes.sub: Mach-Mind-4-Flash: specialize, then integrate, with post-training alone.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Plover! Mach-Mind-4-Flash pushes a compact mixture-of-experts model toward far bigger ones, with post-training alone. Here's the recipe.

scenes.label: Specialize, then integrate
scenes.text: Instead of one mixed-reward RL job, train more than ten domain specialists in parallel, then distill them into one generalist, each sample routed to its teacher.
scenes.mark: each sample routed to its teacher
scenes.say: The idea: train more than ten specialists in parallel, then fuse them into one model, each sample taught by its own specialist.

items.say: Start from a Qwen mixture of experts: thirty-five billion parameters, three billion active. Fine-tune it once.
Branch it into a dozen RL specialists across three tracks: reasoning, general skills, and agents.
Fuse them into one student with multi-teacher on-policy distillation: MOPD.
Then HMPO trims how long it reasons.

steps.say: Each sample carries a routing key. The student answers it under its own policy, so it learns from its own generations, like RL.
The key picks one frozen teacher: the math expert for math, the tool-use expert for tool calls.
Token by token, a reverse KL pulls the student toward that teacher. Each domain's gradient stays clean, so the see-saw mostly disappears.

scenes.title: HMPO: pay for correct and short
scenes.say: HMPO measures its length budget: sample ten answers, and take the median length of the correct ones.

parts.note: zero for a wrong answer, at any length
parts.say: Accuracy reward: zero for any wrong answer.

parts.note: cosine decay while under budget b, then zero
parts.say: Token reward: fades as a correct answer grows, zero past the budget.
Multiply the two, and correctness comes first. The budget tightens as answers shorten.

scenes.label: shorter generations from HMPO, for at most a 0.7-point accuracy drop
scenes.note: trained on math, measured on single-turn reasoning
scenes.say: Trained on math alone, it cuts length nineteen to forty-six percent, for at most zero point seven points of accuracy.

scenes.text: Headroom still sits in post-training: give each skill its own teacher, and fusing a dozen mostly stops being a see-saw.
scenes.mark: give each skill its own teacher
scenes.say: Headroom still sits in post-training: give each skill its own teacher, and fusion mostly stops being a see-saw.

recap: A dozen RL specialists, trained in parallel
MOPD: each sample distilled from its routed teacher
HMPO: the median correct answer sets the budget
scenes.say: To recap: parallel specialists, routed distillation, and a median-length budget.
